item.title: Apple is quietly assembling a US chip supply chain, one layer at a time
item.description: TSMC's vast complex outside Phoenix is central to that effort. The 2,000-acre site is slated to host six fabrication plants along with supporting infrastructure. item.title: US grid battery storage hits record, even as clean energy incentives are rolled back
item.description: The US added 57 gigawatt-hours (GWh) of battery storage capacity to its electric grid last year – enough to supply the annual electricity needs of roughly five million homes.
